description: A London lawyer patented a tripod-mounted revolving flintlock, with round bullets for Christians and square for Turks.
scene: A brass-and-iron flintlock gun on a tall tripod, with one long barrel and a fat revolving cylinder turned by a crank handle at the back, a gentleman in a full wig and long coat demonstrating it in a London yard; it is a single-barrelled gun on three legs, not a wheeled cannon
